purpose: Read-only clean-checkout reproduction of Claude's GOAL3 2026-only k=6/k=10 outer-detail artifact. This is retrospective research, not prospective shadow evidence.

bootstrap.sampling: sorted unique dates; choices(k=17) with replacement

knownLimitations: The 2026 history input is from the k-addtimes/jleague_open_data community mirror, not an official J.League publication-time feed.
All 429 history rows in the audited snapshot share fetchedAt=2026-11-03T23:21:25.123Z; this cannot establish each row's first-known time.
12 of 17 target dates predate the 2026-10-22 alias-map update; the current alias map is not proof of the exact historical mapping consumed by the original forecast process.
The 17-date retrospective cohort is below the predeclared 20-round/60-match prospective adoption threshold.
No production model, market weight, main branch, prediction log, or existing shadow artifact is changed or authorized by this audit.
